description: Get a US bank's filed call report for one quarter — the balance sheet, income statement, regulatory capital, loan and deposit detail as actually reported, with every line item labeled rather than left as a raw code. Answers "show me JPMorgan's call report", "what did this bank report last quarter", "total assets and equity for bank X". Identify the bank by name, FDIC certificate number, or Federal Reserve IDRSSD — the response states which one it resolved on. Pass `schedule` (RC, RI, RCRI, RCN, RCCI, RCE, RCK) to narrow to one schedule. Example: ffiec_call_report({ name: "jpmorgan chase bank" }); ffiec_call_report({ cert: 628, schedule: "RI" }). Keyless.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (as used by the fdic pack)

idrssd.description: Federal Reserve IDRSSD (as used by the CDR)

quarter.description: Quarter end as YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to the latest quarter available

schedule.description: Restrict to one schedule: RC, RI, RCRI, RCN, RCCI, RCE, RCK

name: ffiec_call_report
title: Ffiec Call Report
